testdata.description: Deprecated Package inventory. Ignored unless packagePolicy.legacyTestdata is explicitly enabled and no Package Manifest exists.

sutMetricsMetricSource.title: ATT SUT Metric Source acquisition and mapping definition
sutMetricsMetricSource.description: A Metric Source defines one bounded acquisition over an existing connection. It does not register a Data Source, DBHelper, or Package Tool.

sutMetricsProfileV2.title: ATT flat SUT Metrics Profile
sutMetricsProfileV2.description: A flat selection of Metric Sources and Groups with a bounded allowlist of execution bindings. Profile inheritance is not supported.
